data.name: DOWNTOWN MEXICO HOTEL
data.address: Isabel La Católica 30-Interior R2, Centro Histórico de la Cdad. de México, Centro, Cuauhtémoc, 06000 Ciudad de México, CDMX, Mexico
data.description:
In a 17th-century building with a stone staircase and churchlike touches, this upmarket, trendy hotel is 5 minutes' walk from Zócalo, a bustling main square with a metro station.
Featuring wood furnishings, the streamlined rooms include Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, as well as iPod docks and safes. Most feature exposed stone and/or brickwork; some have sitting areas or balconies. Room service is available.
There's a rooftop bar with views of the city, and an outdoor pool with a breezy poolside bar and a whirlpool. A terrace features stone archways and grand frescoes. Breakfast is available.
